en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a quiet street with early 20th‑century villas and garden fences in a leafless winter setting. A prominent corner wall and trellis-covered garden stand in the foreground; larger residential buildings with ornate roofs and antennas rise behind. The caption at the top in red print reads 'Oberlößnitz. Nizzastrasse.' and a vertical red imprint on the left margin gives the publisher information.
